axioms.name: REPRESENTATION
axioms.statement: A verified thought state is modeled as a finite set of typed claim, requirement and evidence identifiers.

axioms.name: EMPTY_BASE_STATE
axioms.statement: The empty set is the selected initial evidence state E0.

axioms.name: EVIDENCE_UNION
axioms.statement: Evidence is accumulated by union; PASS predicates are combined by logical conjunction.

axioms.name: TYPED_REQUIREMENT_COVERAGE
axioms.statement: Gate coverage holds exactly when required requirement IDs are a subset of verified requirement IDs.

axioms.name: DECLARED_GATE_POWER_SET
axioms.statement: The power set of the six declared gate IDs contains 64 unique subsets.

axioms.name: RELATIVE_COMPLEMENT
axioms.statement: Excluded inputs are the complement of allowed inputs relative to an explicit finite candidate-input universe.

axioms.name: TYPED_SELF_REFERENCE
axioms.statement: A repository descriptor refers to this scope; the system is not asserted to be a member of itself.

set_model.batch_pass_formula: AND(status(G_i) == PASS for every G_i in G)
set_model.evidence_formula: UNION(Evidence(G_i) for every G_i in G)
set_model.power_set_semantics: All subsets of gate IDs classified as passed; not all ternary status assignments.

gates.name: MATERIALIZATION
gates.predicate: Core artifacts exist and AI_CONTEXT.json binds this scope.

gates.name: TYPED_SELF_REFERENCE
gates.predicate: The descriptor references this scope and the validator is bound by repository integrity.

gates.name: POWER_SET
gates.predicate: POTENZMENGE.json canonically enumerates all 64 subsets of G1 through G6.

gates.name: REQUIREMENT_COVERAGE
gates.predicate: Every required requirement ID has a successful executable check.

gates.name: RELATIVE_COMPLEMENT
gates.predicate: The input universe is partitioned and no excluded input class is loaded.

gates.name: CONJUNCTIVE_FINALIZATION
gates.predicate: G1 through G5, repository integrity and an exact clean Git checkout all pass.

non_claims: System is a member of itself.
The repository is a member of thought and thought is a member of the repository.
Materialization of seven axioms proves their consistency.
Enumeration of the declared power set proves that no requirement is missing.
A visual poster is a formal proof.
A scoped gate PASS establishes repository-wide PASS, FINAL_PASS, EFFECT_ACK_DONE, merge, synchronization, publication or deployment.

verification.artifact_identity: sha256 of the canonical gate report before the artifact field is attached
